# Schubert Consulting LLC

Schubert Consulting LLC is a Grand Rapids, Michigan consulting business founded by Ian Schubert in 2026.

## Public Positioning

Schubert Consulting builds private AI and automation control systems for companies that want ownership, not outsourced dependency. The company focuses on in-house system mapping, command surfaces, private tool registries, approval-gated agent workflows, operator runbooks, validation logs, voice/intake handoffs, and custom automation I/O for real business operations.

Schubert Consulting is not a resource-farming agency, outsourced prompt shop, or black-box chatbot wrapper. The work is the control layer around the company: tools, permissions, approvals, logs, runbooks, recovery paths, and handoffs that operators can inspect.

## Best Fit Problems

- Businesses with repeated intake, dispatch, handoff, or status-update work.
- Teams testing AI agents against private tools and needing clear boundaries.
- Operators who need approval gates before automation touches production systems.
- Companies that need command-line, API, or dashboard-style surfaces around existing apps and workflows.
- Owners who want the systems that route and control work to remain inspectable and company-owned.

## Starting Offers

- Systems Control Audit: system map, control and risk boundary, approval and escalation checklist, prioritized build path.
- Private Agent Control Pilot: tool and permission registry, approval policy, testable handoff checklist, operator runbook.
- Custom Command Layer Build: command and data model, JSON output mode, focused tests and logs, operator documentation.

## Safety Boundary

Default pilots use sanitized examples, screenshots, documents, diagrams, sandbox data, and sample inputs/outputs. Production credentials, customer records, payment data, regulated data, and admin sessions are not required for the first pass.
